option_relations.rationale: Uveitic cystoid macular edema is a direct match for the leaf label Uveitic Cystoid Macular Edema
Anastrozole-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema is a direct match for the leaf label Anastrozole-associated Uveitis with Cystoid Macular Edema
Drug-induced uveitis (anastrozole) is a subtype of anastrozole-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema
Idiopathic uveitis with cystoid macular edema is a direct match for the leaf label Idiopathic Uveitis with Cystoid Macular Edema
